facts.business: U. P. Hotels Limited operates hotels under the brand 'Hotel Clarks'.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-compliance with Minimum Public Shareholding (Regulation 38 SEBI LODR), non-achievement of 100% promoter shareholding dematerialization (Regulation 31(2) SEBI LODR), and related party transactions not approved by Audit Committee/Board pending NCLT adjudication (Sections 188, 189 Companies Act, Regulation 23 SEBI LODR). Cumulative BSE penalties for MPS non-compliance amount to Rs. 95.70 lakhs (including GST) up to March 31, 2026.

key_risks: Non-compliance with Minimum Public Shareholding requirements
Non-compliance with promoter shareholding dematerialization requirements
Related party transactions not approved due to pending NCLT litigation
Regulatory penalties from BSE for continued non-compliance
Uncertain outcome of voluntary delisting process
facts.related_party_note: Related Party Transactions entered into during previous years and continuing in current financial year could not be approved by Audit Committee and Board of Directors being part of a legal matter pending before the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) for adjudication. These RPTs are not entered in the Register maintained under Section 189 of the Act.
